```{r}
# Paths to LD matrix (r^2) and BIM file
ld_path  <- "/1KG.EUR.onList.refLD.ld"
bim_path <- "/1KG.EUR.onList.reid.bim"

LD  <- as.matrix(read.table(ld_path, header = FALSE, check.names = FALSE))
bim <- read.table(bim_path, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


colnames(bim)[1:6] <- c("CHR","ID","CM","POS","A1","A2")

ld_ids <- bim$ID
stopifnot(nrow(LD) == length(ld_ids))
rownames(LD) <- colnames(LD) <- ld_ids


R_all <- LD
R_all[R_all < 0] <- 0           
R_all <- sqrt(R_all)

# LD-allele reference table
ld_ref <- data.frame(
  snp    = bim$ID,
  A1_ref = toupper(bim$A1),
  A2_ref = toupper(bim$A2)
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(susieR)

attach_ld_cc <- function(ds, trait_label) {

  
  idx <- match(ds$snp, ld_ref$snp)
  keep <- !is.na(idx)

  if (sum(keep) < 10) {
    warning(trait_label, ": only ", sum(keep), " SNPs match LD reference")
  }

  
  ds$snp     <- ds$snp[keep]
  ds$beta    <- ds$beta[keep]
  ds$varbeta <- ds$varbeta[keep]
  ds$MAF     <- ds$MAF[keep]
  ds$A1      <- ds$A1[keep]
  ds$A2      <- ds$A2[keep]
  ds$REF     <- ds$REF[keep]
  ds$ALT     <- ds$ALT[keep]
  if (!is.null(ds$pos)) ds$pos <- ds$pos[keep]

  a1_ref <- ld_ref$A1_ref[idx[keep]]
  a2_ref <- ld_ref$A2_ref[idx[keep]]

  # flip where A1 is the other allele
  flip <- ds$A1 != a1_ref & ds$A1 == a2_ref
  ds$beta[flip] <- -ds$beta[flip]

  
  mismatch <- !( (ds$A1 == a1_ref & ds$A2 == a2_ref) |
                 (ds$A1 == a2_ref & ds$A2 == a1_ref) )
  if (any(mismatch)) {
    message(trait_label, ": dropping ", sum(mismatch),
            " SNPs with incompatible alleles vs LD ref")
    keep2 <- !mismatch
    ds$snp     <- ds$snp[keep2]
    ds$beta    <- ds$beta[keep2]
    ds$varbeta <- ds$varbeta[keep2]
    ds$MAF     <- ds$MAF[keep2]
    ds$A1      <- ds$A1[keep2]
    ds$A2      <- ds$A2[keep2]
    ds$REF     <- ds$REF[keep2]
    ds$ALT     <- ds$ALT[keep2]
    if (!is.null(ds$pos)) ds$pos <- ds$pos[keep2]
    idx <- idx[keep][keep2]
  } else {
    idx <- idx[keep]
  }

  # subset LD matrix
  ds$LD <- R_all[idx, idx]

  message(trait_label, ": attached LD for ", length(ds$snp), " SNPs")

  ds
}

runsusie_cc <- function(ds, L = 10, maxit = 10000) {
  z <- ds$beta / sqrt(ds$varbeta)

  susie_fit <- susie_rss(
    z        = z,
    R        = ds$LD,
    n        = ds$N,
    L        = L,
    coverage = 0.95,
    max_iter = maxit
  )

  susie_fit$snp <- ds$snp
  if (!is.null(ds$pos)) susie_fit$pos <- ds$pos
  susie_fit$label <- ds$label
  susie_fit
}


datasets$PD  <- attach_ld_cc(datasets$PD,  "PD")
datasets$MSA <- attach_ld_cc(datasets$MSA, "MSA")
datasets$AD  <- attach_ld_cc(datasets$AD,  "AD")
datasets$CJD <- attach_ld_cc(datasets$CJD, "CJD")
datasets$FTD <- attach_ld_cc(datasets$FTD, "FTD")

susie_ALS <- runsusie_cc(dataset.als)
susie_PSP <- runsusie_cc(dataset.psp)
susie_PD  <- runsusie_cc(datasets$PD)
susie_MSA <- runsusie_cc(datasets$MSA)
susie_AD  <- runsusie_cc(datasets$AD)
susie_CJD <- runsusie_cc(datasets$CJD)
susie_FTD <- runsusie_cc(datasets$FTD)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

summarise_cs <- function(susie_fit, gwas_df, trait_label) {
  
  pip_tbl <- data.frame(
    SNP = susie_fit$snp,
    pip = susie_fit$pip,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  cs_list <- susie_fit$sets$cs
  
  if (is.null(cs_list)) {
    warning(trait_label, ": no credible sets found by SuSiE.")
    return(list(
      snp_level = NULL,
      cs_level  = NULL
    ))
  }
  
  cs_tbl <- lapply(seq_along(cs_list), function(i) {
    snp_idx <- cs_list[[i]]
    data.frame(
      SNP   = susie_fit$snp[snp_idx],
      cs_id = paste0("CS", i),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  snp_level <- pip_tbl %>%
    left_join(cs_tbl, by = "SNP") %>%
    left_join(gwas_df %>% select(SNP, pos, P), by = "SNP") %>%
    mutate(trait = trait_label)
  
  cs_level <- snp_level %>%
    filter(!is.na(cs_id)) %>%
    group_by(trait, cs_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_snps   = n(),
      lead_SNP = SNP[which.max(pip)],
      max_pip  = max(pip, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_pos  = min(pos, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_pos  = max(pos, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(span_kb = (max_pos - min_pos) / 1e3)
  
  list(
    snp_level = snp_level,
    cs_level  = cs_level
  )
}

psp_cs  <- summarise_cs(susie_PSP, PSP_f, "PSP")
als_cs  <- summarise_cs(susie_ALS, ALS_f, "ALS")
ftd_cs  <- summarise_cs(susie_FTD, FTD_h, "FTD")
ad_cs  <- summarise_cs(susie_AD, AD_h, "AD")
msa_cs <- summarise_cs(susie_MSA, MSA_h, "MSA")
pd_cs <- summarise_cs(susie_PD, PD_h, "PD")
cjd_cs <- summarise_cs(susie_CJD, CJD_f, "CJD")

psp_cs$cs_level
als_cs$cs_level
ftd_cs$cs_level


cs_all <- bind_rows(
  psp_cs$cs_level,
  als_cs$cs_level,
  ftd_cs$cs_level
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

plot_cs_manhattan <- function(cs_obj, trait_label, title_prefix = NULL) {
  
  snps <- cs_obj$snp_level
  
  # credible set colour palette
  cs_ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(snps$cs_id)))
  n_cs <- length(cs_ids)
  
  cs_cols <- if (n_cs > 0) {
    setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, n_cs), "Set1")[1:n_cs], cs_ids)
  } else character(0)
  
  col_vec <- c("not_CS" = "grey80", cs_cols)
  
  snps$cs_id_plot <- ifelse(is.na(snps$cs_id), "not_CS", snps$cs_id)
  snps$neglogP <- -log10(snps$P)
  
  # top SNP labels (max pip per CS)
  top_snps <- snps %>%
    group_by(cs_id) %>%
    filter(pip == max(pip)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(cs_id))
  
  p <- ggplot(snps, aes(x = pos, y = neglogP)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = cs_id_plot, size = pip), alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_vec, name = "Credible set") +
    scale_size(range = c(1.2, 4), name = "PIP") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = top_snps,
      aes(label = SNP),
      size = 3,
      min.segment.length = 0
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(title_prefix, trait_label, " fine-mapping (SuSiE)"),
      x = "Genomic position (chr 3, MOBP locus)",
      y = expression(-log[10](P))
    )
  
  p
}
p_psp <- plot_cs_manhattan(psp_cs, "PSP", "Credible sets: ")
p_als <- plot_cs_manhattan(als_cs, "ALS", "Credible sets: ")
p_ftd <- plot_cs_manhattan(ftd_cs, "FTD", "Credible sets: ")
```

```{r}
plot_pip_track <- function(cs_obj, trait_label) {
  snps <- cs_obj$snp_level
  snps$cs_id_plot <- ifelse(is.na(snps$cs_id), "not_CS", snps$cs_id)
  cs_ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(snps$cs_id)))
  n_cs <- length(cs_ids)
  
  cs_cols <- if (n_cs > 0) {
    setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, n_cs), "Set1")[1:n_cs], cs_ids)
  } else character(0)
  col_vec <- c("not_CS" = "grey80", cs_cols)
  
  ggplot(snps, aes(x = pos, y = pip, colour = cs_id_plot)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_vec, name = "Credible set") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste(trait_label, "posterior inclusion probabilities"),
      x = "Genomic position",
      y = "PIP"
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)



plot_pip_with_labels <- function(cs_obj, disease_label,
                                 top_n_per_cs = 3,
                                 min_pip = 0.01) {
  # cs_obj is the list from summarise_cs()
  snps <- cs_obj$snp_level %>%
    mutate(
      cs  = ifelse(is.na(cs_id), "not_CS", cs_id),
      PIP = pip
    )
  
  # label only top K SNPs per CS with PIP >= min_pip
  lab_df <- snps %>%
    filter(cs != "not_CS", PIP >= min_pip) %>%
    group_by(cs) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = PIP,
              n = top_n_per_cs,
              with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  ggplot(snps, aes(x = pos, y = PIP, colour = cs)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = lab_df,
      aes(label = SNP),
      size = 3,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.1,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        "CS1"    = "#d62728",
        "CS2"    = "#1f77b4",
        "CS3"    = "#2ca02c",
        "not_CS" = "grey75"
      ),
      name = "Credible set"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste(disease_label, "posterior inclusion probabilities"),
      x = "Genomic position (chr3, MOBP locus)",
      y = "PIP"
    )
}

p_pip_psp <- plot_pip_with_labels(psp_cs, "PSP")
p_pip_als <- plot_pip_with_labels(als_cs, "ALS")
p_pip_ftd <- plot_pip_with_labels(ftd_cs, "FTD")

library(patchwork)

p_pip_psp + p_pip_als + p_pip_ftd +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ggplot2)


mobp_gff <- gencode_gff %>%
  filter(gene_name == "MOBP")


unique(mobp_gff$seqid)
unique(mobp_gff$strand)


mobp_exons_raw <- mobp_gff %>%
  filter(type == "exon") %>%
  select(seqid, start, end, strand)


gr_exons <- GRanges(
  seqnames = mobp_exons_raw$seqid,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = mobp_exons_raw$start,
                     end   = mobp_exons_raw$end)
)

gr_exons_merged <- reduce(gr_exons)
mobp_exons_merged <- as.data.frame(gr_exons_merged) %>%
  rename(seqid = seqnames) %>%
  select(seqid, start, end)


gene_start <- min(mobp_exons_merged$start)
gene_end   <- max(mobp_exons_merged$end)


ggplot() +
  # gene backbone = intron line
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = gene_start, xend = gene_end, y = 0, yend = 0),
    linewidth = 0.6,
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +
  # merged exons as boxes on the backbone
  geom_rect(
    data = mobp_exons_merged,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end,
        ymin = -0.1, ymax = 0.1),
    fill = "grey20"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(gene_start - 2000, gene_end + 2000),  # add a bit of padding
    ylim = c(-0.3, 0.3),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic position on chr3",
    y = NULL,
    title = "MOBP gene structure (merged exons across transcripts)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(GenomicRanges)

mobp_exons <- gencode_gff %>%
  filter(gene_name == "MOBP", type == "exon")


gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = mobp_exons$seqid,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = mobp_exons$start, end = mobp_exons$end)
)

gr_merged <- reduce(gr)

mobp_exons_merged <- as.data.frame(gr_merged) %>%
  transmute(start = start, end = end)


gene_start <- min(mobp_exons_merged$start)
gene_end   <- max(mobp_exons_merged$end)


p_strip <- ggplot() +
  # intron backbone
  geom_segment(aes(x = gene_start, xend = gene_end, y = 0, yend = 0),
               linewidth = 0.6, colour = "grey40") +
  # exons (merged)
  geom_rect(data = mobp_exons_merged,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -0.1, ymax = 0.1),
            fill = "grey20") +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(gene_start - 2000, gene_end + 2000),
    ylim = c(-0.3, 0.3),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)


psp_cs1 <- psp_cs$snp_level %>%
  filter(cs_id == "CS1") %>%
  pull(SNP) %>%
  unique()

als_cs1 <- als_cs$snp_level %>%
  filter(cs_id == "CS1") %>%
  pull(SNP) %>%
  unique()

ftd_cs1 <- ftd_cs$snp_level %>%
  filter(cs_id == "CS1") %>%
  pull(SNP) %>%
  unique()


all_cs_snps <- tibble(SNP = unique(c(psp_cs1, als_cs1, ftd_cs1)))


cs_membership <- all_cs_snps %>%
  mutate(
    PSP = SNP %in% psp_cs1,
    ALS = SNP %in% als_cs1,
    FTD = SNP %in% ftd_cs1
  )


pos_lookup <- bind_rows(
  ALS_f %>% select(SNP, pos),
  PSP_f %>% select(SNP, pos),
  FTD_h %>% select(SNP, pos)
) %>%
  distinct(SNP, .keep_all = TRUE)

cs_snps_pos <- cs_membership %>%
  left_join(pos_lookup, by = "SNP")


cs_snps_pos <- cs_snps_pos %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      PSP & ALS & !FTD ~ "Shared PSP+ALS",
      ALS & !PSP & !FTD ~ "ALS only",
      PSP & !ALS & !FTD ~ "PSP only",
      FTD & !PSP & !ALS ~ "FTD only",
      TRUE              ~ "Other"
    )
  )

gene_start <- min(mobp_exons_merged$start)
gene_end   <- max(mobp_exons_merged$end)
mobp_exons_merged  # from the code that made your strip

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)


snp_y <- 0.25

min_pos <- min(cs_snps_pos$pos, na.rm = TRUE)

left_lim  <- min(min_pos, gene_start) - 2000   # include upstream FTD
right_lim <- gene_end + 2000                  # always keep full gene

p_mobp_cs <- ggplot() +
  # intron backbone
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = gene_start, xend = gene_end, y = 0, yend = 0),
    linewidth = 0.6,
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +
  # exons
  geom_rect(
    data = mobp_exons_merged,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -0.1, ymax = 0.1),
    fill = "grey20"
  ) +
  # SNP stems
  geom_segment(
    data = cs_snps_pos,
    aes(x = pos, xend = pos, y = 0, yend = 0.25, colour = group),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  # SNP points
  geom_point(
    data = cs_snps_pos,
    aes(x = pos, y = 0.25, colour = group),
    size = 2
  ) +
  # labels for shared PSP+ALS
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = cs_snps_pos ,
    aes(x = pos, y = 0.25, label = SNP, colour = group),
    nudge_y = 0.1,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Shared PSP+ALS" = "#E31A1C",
      "ALS only"       = "#1F78B4",
      "FTD only"       = "#33A02C"
    ),
    name = "CS1 membership"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(left_lim, right_lim),
    ylim = c(-0.3, 0.5),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y   = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y  = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic position (chr3)",
    title = "CS1 credible SNPs across MOBP locus"
  )

p_mobp_cs
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)


all_cs1_snps <- union(union(psp_cs_snps, als_cs1), ftd_cs1)


summary_tbl <- tibble(SNP = all_cs1_snps) %>%
  mutate(
    PSP = ifelse(SNP %in% psp_cs1, "✓", ""),
    ALS = ifelse(SNP %in% als_cs1, "✓", ""),
    FTD = ifelse(SNP %in% ftd_cs1, "✓", "")
  )

summary_tbl <- summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      PSP == "✓" & ALS == "✓" ~ "Shared PSP+ALS",
      ALS == "✓" & PSP == ""  ~ "ALS only",
      FTD == "✓"              ~ "FTD only",
      TRUE                    ~ "Other"
    )
  )


get_pip_df <- function(cs_obj, label){
  cs_obj %>% 
    select(SNP, PIP) %>% 
    rename(!!paste0(label, "_PIP") := PIP)
}

pip_psp <- get_pip_df(psp_cs, "PSP")
pip_als <- get_pip_df(als_cs, "ALS")
pip_ftd <- get_pip_df(ftd_cs, "FTD")


summary_tbl <- summary_tbl %>%
  left_join(pip_psp, by = "SNP") %>%
  left_join(pip_als, by = "SNP") %>%
  left_join(pip_ftd, by = "SNP")


summary_tbl <- summary_tbl %>%
  arrange(desc(Group), SNP)

summary_tbl
```

```{r}
  transmute(

    pos,

  )

  transmute(
    SNP,
    pos,
    FTD_PIP = pip,
    FTD_CS1 = TRUE
  )

cs1_summary <- psp_cs1_df %>%
  full_join(als_cs1_df, by = c("SNP", "pos")) %>%
  full_join(ftd_cs1_df, by = c("SNP", "pos"))


cs1_summary <- cs1_summary %>%
  mutate(
    PSP_CS1 = if_else(is.na(PSP_CS1), FALSE, PSP_CS1),
    ALS_CS1 = if_else(is.na(ALS_CS1), FALSE, ALS_CS1),
    FTD_CS1 = if_else(is.na(FTD_CS1), FALSE, FTD_CS1),
    PSP_PIP = if_else(is.na(PSP_PIP), 0, PSP_PIP),
    ALS_PIP = if_else(is.na(ALS_PIP), 0, ALS_PIP),
    FTD_PIP = if_else(is.na(FTD_PIP), 0, FTD_PIP)
  )



cs1_summary <- cs1_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      PSP_CS1 & ALS_CS1 & !FTD_CS1 ~ "Shared PSP+ALS",
      ALS_CS1 & !PSP_CS1 & !FTD_CS1 ~ "ALS only",
      FTD_CS1 & !PSP_CS1 & !ALS_CS1 ~ "FTD only",
      TRUE                          ~ "Other"
    ),
    PSP = if_else(PSP_CS1, "✓", ""),
    ALS = if_else(ALS_CS1, "✓", ""),
    FTD = if_else(FTD_CS1, "✓", "")
  ) %>%
  select(
    SNP, pos,
    PSP, ALS, FTD,
    PSP_PIP, ALS_PIP, FTD_PIP,
    Group
  ) %>%
  arrange(Group, SNP)

cs1_summary
```
